name: agenthub-codex
description: Monitor and control multiple Codex app-server sessions from one VS Code view.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Codexセッションはまだありません。
[新しいセッションを開始](command:agentHub.startSession)

commands.title: AgentHub: 新しいCodexセッション
AgentHub: デバイスコードでログイン
AgentHub: ログインをキャンセル
AgentHub: セッション一覧を更新
AgentHub: セッション詳細を開く
AgentHub: グループ差分を開く
AgentHub: リポジトリ差分を更新

view/title.when: view == agentHub.sessions && agentHub.authenticationStatus != authenticated && agentHub.authenticationStatus != logging_in

agentHub.codexArgs.description: Arguments inserted before app-server. Intended for test harnesses and custom launchers.

agentHub.notifyOnActionRequired.description: Show notifications when a session needs approval or input.

agentHub.notifyOnComplete.description: Show notifications when a session completes.

agentHub.notifyOnFailure.description: Show notifications when a session fails.

agentHub.autoApprove.allowedCommands.description: Auto-approve only command lines that exactly match an entry while session Auto mode is enabled. Recursive deletion and direct network commands still require confirmation.

agentHub.autoApprove.allowedPaths.description: Auto-approve file change grants only under these paths while session Auto mode is enabled. Use ${sessionRoot} for the session working folder.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test dist/test/authentication-manager.test.js dist/test/approval-policy.test.js dist/test/session-manager.test.js dist/test/protocol-boundaries.test.js dist/test/app-server-client.test.js dist/test/markdown-renderer.test.js dist/test/git-repository-reader.test.js dist/test/repository-file-reader.test.js dist/test/github-issue-client.test.js
